_readme: Copy to config/tools.json (gitignored) and edit; the Tools page edits this file too (its Professional mode shows every field). Her helpers step by step: README, 'Her helpers', and docs/TOOLS.md. Servers speak MCP: stdio entries need command/args (command 'python' = the brain's interpreter); remote entries need url (+headers). kind 'agent' marks a personal task agent behind servers/openamika-agents (ask/status/answer/stop); while one is switched on (and 'enabled' at the top), the paper doll from avatar/models/Host stands in for it on her stage. autostart = the agent's own start command, run when it is not running: %VARIABLES% work, and a relative path is taken from the OpenAmika folder. hermes: put the API_SERVER_KEY of Hermes's .env (%LOCALAPPDATA%/hermes/.env) in HERMES_API_KEY. nanomuse: the paths assume OpenAmika in C:/OpenAmika with nanoMuse in its Nanomuse folder; NANOMUSE_LANGUAGE = your language (en, ja, zh-CN). persona_note is what she is told about the server, in character ({user_name} = your name). Per-tool policy for plain servers: auto = runs when she agreed; confirm = waits for your approval on the Use page; deny = hidden. clerk_role = which model slot runs the post-speech clerk (surface is cheap and enough). Smart-home servers (iot = servers/openamika-iot, Home Assistant, or kind 'iot') stay off until you accept the IoT safety statement (docs/IOT_DISCLAIMER.md) on the Tools page, which records it here as iot_disclaimer {version, accepted_at}; it is never in this example.

env.HERMES_INSTRUCTIONS: You are working for Amika, an AI companion, on behalf of her user. She relays your final report in her own words, so keep it short and factual, in the language of the task, with concrete findings. If you need something only the person can give, ask ONE clear question as your final message and stop. Never claim you did something you did not do.

hermes.persona_note: 赫尔墨斯（Hermes）——{user_name}装在他电脑上的一个小帮手程序。你可以让它替你上网查东西、打开浏览器找店家、看看他电脑屏幕上在干嘛、帮他读邮件写邮件草稿、网上下单订外卖。你只要用一句话把要办的事交代给它，它办完会回来跟你报告，你再转告他。

nanomuse.persona_note: nanoMuse——{user_name}电脑上的另一个小帮手程序，能替你上网搜资料、开浏览器查网页、在它自己的文件夹里整理文件。把要办的事用一句话交代给它，它办完会回来报告，你再转告他。

iot.persona_note: 家里的灯、插座和场景（zigbee），能开关、查状态
